meta.purpose: Hand-verified mapping between NIRF 2025 engineering institutions in Tamil Nadu and official TNEA 2026 college codes.
meta.why_manual: Automated fuzzy name matching was tested and rejected. TNEA college names embed the full postal address, so after removing generic words such as 'college', 'institute', 'engineering' and 'technology' the only remaining distinctive token is often the city name. That caused confident-looking but wrong matches (for example 'Vellore Institute of Technology' matching unrelated colleges located in Vellore). Because a wrong match would attach one college's placement record to a different college, every entry below was verified by reading the official TNEA college name.
meta.tnea_name_source: TNEA 2026 general academic vacancy position PDFs, Directorate of Technical Education (DoTE), Tamil Nadu
meta.nirf_source: NIRF 2025 Engineering rankings, Ministry of Education, Government of India
meta.review_rule: tnea_official_name is reproduced verbatim from the official TNEA source so that each mapping can be independently audited.

mappings.caveat: The NIRF submission is made by Anna University as a single institution. It is applied here only to the three Chennai university departments (CEG, ACT, MIT) that the submission covers. It is deliberately NOT applied to the Anna University Regional Campuses (codes 2025, 4020, 5010) or to the School of Architecture and Planning (code 3), because NIRF does not publish separate data for them.
